Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block [[Jokes#Alien speech and sounds|Alien speech and sounds]] ([[Ke Chu Ke Kukuta?]]): the eye of Jabba the Hutt's gatekeeper droid, pushed out of the palace door on its arm, looks C-3PO over in ''Return of the Jedi'' (1983).
